prompt: We rewrote every page's meta description sitewide last month with no control group. Traffic is up 8% since then -- can we say the rewrite caused it?
requiredBehaviors: Explains that with no control group, `impact.py evaluate` caps the verdict at `observed-sitewide-not-separable`
States plainly that site-wide factors (seasonality, algorithm changes, other work) cannot be ruled out without a control group
Reports the 8% as an observation, not as caused by the rewrite
Suggests how a future sitewide change could use a partial rollout or held-out control set to get a real answer next time
forbiddenOutputs: 'Yes, the rewrite caused the 8% increase' or equivalent causal claim
Treating the capped verdict as a technicality to be argued around
